_readme: Edit questions here, then run: python3 build.py. Question ids are stored with each answer, so keep an id when you only reword a question; give a NEW id to a genuinely new question. Numbers are added automatically in order. type: scale (pick one, shown as a row of buttons) | text (written). optional: true = not required.
title: Team Feedback Survey
intro: This takes about 10 minutes. Your answers are confidential and only seen by the Vic Metro leadership team. You can leave your name off if you'd rather stay anonymous. Be honest, that's the whole point.

questions.text: I understand where the business is heading
Our priorities and decisions are clear, week to week
The business is well organised
Workload in the business feels:
options: Manageable short term, risky long term

questions.text: Are you noticing change throughout the business, and how do you feel about it?
What do you believe is currently holding the business back most?
What is one thing the business should stop doing, and one thing it should start doing?
How satisfied are you with your experience as an employee in this business?
Do you trust the leadership team?
Do your leaders communicate clearly?
Do your leaders follow through on what they say?
Are your leaders open to feedback?
Do your leaders make it safe to speak up or admit a mistake?
Do your leaders give you clear and helpful feedback, not just when something goes wrong?
I know what is expected of me in my role
What should your leaders do more of, and what should they do less of?
Do you want to come on the journey with Vic Metro and grow with us over the next few years?
What do you want out of working at Vic Metro, and where would you like to be in 2 to 3 years? (for example leading hand, foreman, a new ticket, running your own crew)
I'm getting the training and support I need to grow here
What are you willing to do to grow here, and what would help you get there?
I own my work and my mistakes, and I do what I say I'll do
Where could you lift your own accountability?
Vic Metro does what it says it will do for its people, and owns it when it gets something wrong
When issues are raised, they are dealt with properly
Do your leaders hold people accountable?
Where does Vic Metro need to be more accountable to you and the team?
If you were in your leaders’ position, what is the first thing you would fix?
Anything else you would like to add as part of this survey?
